བཏགས་གྲོལ: liberation through wearing: the name of a companion text whose mantras free by being worn on the body (btags, past stem of 'dogs 'to tie on, attach' + grol 'be freed')
བསྒྲགས་པས: by proclaiming, because it is proclaimed (bsgrags, past stem of sgrog 'to proclaim, cry aloud' (sgrog / bsgrags / bsgrag / sgrogs) + -pa + -s 'by, because')
མཎྜལ: maṇḍala: the round offering plate set with precious things; a circle, a deity's realm (Sanskrit maṇḍala, written with stacked letters)
བཀོད་པ: set, arranged, set out (bkod, past stem of 'god 'to arrange, set out' ('god / bkod / dgod / khod) + -pa)
འདྲ་བས: because it is like, being like ('dra ba 'alike, similar' + -s 'because')
བསྒྲགས་པར: to proclaim, proclaiming (bsgrags, past stem of sgrog 'to proclaim' + -pa + -r 'to'): bsgrags par gyis shig 'do the proclaiming!'
བསྟན: shown, having shown (bstan, past and future stem of ston 'to show, teach')
ངོ་སྤྲད་པར: to point out, to be pointed out (ngo sprad: sprad, the past and future stem of sprod (sprod / sprad / sprad / sprod), in ngo sprod 'point out, face-introduce', + -pa + -r 'to'): ngo sprad par bya 'is to be pointed out'
དཔལ་ཆེན: great glorious (dpal 'glory' + chen 'great'); a title of the herukas
བུདྡྷ་ཧེ་རུ་ཀ: Buddha Heruka, 'the blood-drinker of the buddha family' (Sanskrit buddha 'awakened one' + heruka 'blood-drinking wrathful deity', written in Tibetan letters)
བསྒྲད་པ: perhaps a spelling of bgrad pa 'spread wide, set apart' (uncertain; said of legs planted in a wide stance)
སྨུག་ནག་ཏུ: in dark maroon, as dark maroon (smug nag + -tu 'as, in'): smug nag tu yod pa 'being dark maroon'
སྡང་མིག་ཏུ: with a glare, glaringly (sdang 'hatred' + mig 'eye' + -tu 'as, with')
གཟིགས་པ: looking, gazing (gzigs, the respectful word for 'look', + -pa)
ཟངས་ཡག་ཏུ: perhaps 'with a copper gleam' (uncertain): zangs 'copper' + yag 'good, fine' + -tu 'as, with'
ཨ་ལ་ལ: a la la: a cry of delight or wonder, a laughing exclamation
ཧ་ཧའི: of 'ha ha', the sound of laughter (ha ha + -'i 'of'; the reading is doubtful, perhaps for ha he'i)
གད་རྒྱང: a far-carrying laugh, loud laughter (gad 'laugh' + rgyang 'far')
སྒྲོག་པ: crying out, sounding (sgrog, the present stem of sgrog 'to proclaim, cry aloud' (past bsgrags), + -pa)
ཞེས་པ: so called, what is called (zhes 'thus, so', closing a name or a quotation, + -pa)
བཤུགས: perhaps a whistling or hissing sound (uncertain; the spelling bshugs is not a known word)
དབུ་སྐྲ: hair of the head, the respectful word (dbu 'head', respectful, + skra 'hair')
འཕྱོ: to stream, fly loose in the wind ('phyo)
བར་བ: the middle one (bar + -ba, the print's other spelling of bar pa)
ཐོང་གཤོལ: plough (thong gshol), the farmer's implement carried as an emblem
བསྣམས་པར: holding (bsnams, past stem of snom, the respectful verb 'to take, to hold' (snom / bsnams / bsnam / snoms), + -pa + -r, which runs on to what follows)
བུདྡྷ་ཀྲོ་ཏི་ཤྭ་རི་མ: Buddhakrodhīśvarī, 'Wrathful Lady of the buddha family' (Sanskrit buddha + krodhī 'wrathful', written kro ti, + īśvarī 'sovereign lady', in Tibetan letters, with the Tibetan feminine -ma)
གཡས་པས: with the right (hand) (g.yas pa 'the right one' + -s 'by, with')
འཁྱུད: to embrace, hold in the arms ('khyud)
གཡོན་པས: with the left (hand) (g.yon pa 'the left one' + -s 'by, with')
ཞལ་དུ: to the mouth, to the face (zhal 'face, mouth', the respectful word, + -du 'to')
སྟོབ་པ: perhaps giving to eat, feeding (stob + -pa; the sense is not sure)
རྐན་སྒྲ: palate sound, a clicking made with the tongue (rkan 'palate' + sgra 'sound')
ཐུག་ཆོམ: thug chom, perhaps a word for a clacking sound (uncertain)
སྤུ་སེབ: the gaps between body hairs (spu 'body hair' + seb, the print's spelling of gseb 'gap, midst'; uncertain)
བཏེགས་པའི: of what is lifted, raised (btegs, past stem of 'degs 'to lift' + -pa + -'i 'of')
བརྐྱང་བསྐུམ་དུ: stretched and drawn in (brkyang 'stretched out' + bskum 'drawn in, bent' + -du): of the posture with one leg out and one bent
བཞུགས་པར: sitting, seated (bzhugs, the respectful word for 'sit, dwell', + -pa + -r, which runs on to what follows)
མངོན་སུམ: manifest, directly perceived, before one's eyes (mngon sum)
ཉི: perhaps for nyid 'itself, very', its final d not printed (uncertain)
དེ་ཀ: just that, that very (de 'that' + -ka, which stresses it)
སྐུར: as the body, in the body of (sku 'body' + -r 'as, in')
དུས་མཉམ་མོ: are at the same time (dus 'time' + mnyam 'equal' + the sentence-ending -o, written -mo after m)
ཡི་དམ་དུ: as the yidam (yi dam 'one's chosen deity' + -du 'as, to')
བཛྲ་ཧེ་རུ་ཀ: Vajra Heruka, 'the blood-drinker of the vajra family' (Sanskrit vajra 'diamond-thunderbolt' + heruka, in Tibetan letters)
བགྲད་པ: spread wide, set apart (bgrad + -pa); said of legs planted in a wide stance
བྷན་དྷ: skull-cup, vessel (Sanskrit bhāṇḍa 'vessel', in Tibetan letters)
བར་མ: the middle one (bar 'between, middle' + -ma), the same as bar pa
མཐོང་ཤོལ: plough: a spelling of thong gshol (mthong written for thong, shol for gshol); the reading is doubtful
བཛྲ་ཀྲོ་ཏི་ཤྭ་རི་མ: Vajrakrodhīśvarī, 'Wrathful Lady of the vajra family' (Sanskrit vajra + krodhī 'wrathful', written kro ti, + īśvarī 'sovereign lady', in Tibetan letters, with the Tibetan feminine -ma)
ལས་སྒྲིབ: karmic obscuration, the veil that one's past deeds lay on the mind (las 'deed, karma' + sgrib 'obscuration')
རིན་པོ་ཆེའི: of the jewel, of the precious (rin po che 'jewel, precious thing' + -'i 'of')
རཏྣ་ཧེ་རུ་ཀ: Ratna Heruka, 'the blood-drinker of the jewel family' (Sanskrit ratna 'jewel' + heruka, in Tibetan letters)
ཁཊྭཾ་ག: khaṭvāṅga, the staff topped with skulls (Sanskrit khaṭvāṅga, written in two syllables, khaTwaM ga; also written kha TwaM ga)
ཏྲི་ཤུལ: trident (Sanskrit triśūla, in a Tibetan spelling)
རཏྣ་ཀྲོ་ཏི་ཤྭ་རི་མ: Ratnakrodhīśvarī, 'Wrathful Lady of the jewel family' (Sanskrit ratna + krodhī 'wrathful', written kro ti, + īśvarī 'sovereign lady', in Tibetan letters, with the Tibetan feminine -ma)
གཤིན་རྗེར: as the Lord of Death, Yama (gshin rje 'lord of the dead' + -r 'as')
བཅུ་གཅིག་པ: eleventh (bcu gcig 'eleven' + -pa, which makes the ordinal)
བསུ་བར: to meet, to welcome (bsu 'to meet, welcome' + -ba + -r 'to'): bsu bar 'ong 'comes to meet'
པདྨ་ཧེ་རུ་ཀ: Padma Heruka, 'the blood-drinker of the lotus family' (Sanskrit padma 'lotus' + heruka, in Tibetan letters)
ཁ་ཊྭཾ་ག: khaṭvāṅga, the staff topped with skulls (Sanskrit khaṭvāṅga, written in three syllables, kha TwaM ga; also written khaTwaM ga)
རྔེ: perhaps for rnge'u, a small drum (uncertain; the word as printed is not known)
པདྨ་ཀྲོ་ཏི་ཤྭ་རི་མ: Padmakrodhīśvarī, 'Wrathful Lady of the lotus family' (Sanskrit padma + krodhī 'wrathful', written kro ti, + īśvarī 'sovereign lady', in Tibetan letters, with the Tibetan feminine -ma)
ཞལ་སྦྱོར: union, the joining of faces (zhal 'face', the respectful word, + sbyor, the present stem of sbyor 'to join' (sbyor / sbyar / sbyar / sbyor)); said of a buddha and consort in union; beside zhal sbyar, with the past stem
བསྒོམ་ཤིག: meditate on! (bsgom, future stem of sgom 'to meditate' (sgom / bsgoms / bsgom / sgoms), + shig, which marks a command)

__broaden__.རབ: best, highest · very, intensely, before a verb or adjective (rab 'bar ba 'blazing intensely')
__broaden__.ཕྲ: subtle, fine, thin (phra) · inlay, fine inset work (phra): g.yu'i phra 'turquoise inlay'
